behaviors.given: Given a valid portal session with at least 30 seconds remaining before access expiry
behaviors.when: When mouse movement occurs every 100 milliseconds for 15 seconds
behaviors.then: Then at least one successful renewal occurs before the controlled interval ends
negative_cases: Idle periods do not trigger activity renewal.

behaviors.given: Given a valid portal session with at least 30 seconds remaining before access expiry

behaviors.given: Given a valid portal session with at least 30 seconds remaining before access expiry
behaviors.when: When scroll activity occurs every 100 milliseconds for 15 seconds

behaviors.given: Given successful renewal responses and accepted user activity before each access deadline
behaviors.when: When a controlled clock advances through four hours of continued activity
behaviors.then: Then zero fresh SSO prompts occur solely because elapsed session time crosses an earlier maximum
negative_cases: Backend failure and SSO policy require separate system evidence.

behaviors.given: Given an idle-expiry prompt and a usable refresh token
behaviors.when: When the user selects renewal and its request remains pending
behaviors.then: Then the prompt has zero successful closure transitions before renewal succeeds
negative_cases: Rejected renewal keeps the prompt open and permits another attempt.

behaviors.given: Given an idle-expiry prompt and a usable refresh token
behaviors.then: Then the prompt closes exactly once after completion
negative_cases: Rejected renewal keeps the prompt open and permits another attempt.

behaviors.given: Given an idle-expiry prompt and an unsuccessful refresh-based renewal request
behaviors.then: Then the prompt has zero successful closure transitions and permits another renewal attempt
negative_cases: Rejected renewal keeps the prompt open and permits another attempt.
